placements.title: Migrating Analytics Pipeline from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB for Query Speed and Licensing Efficiency
placements.frame: How does transitioning the analytics pipeline from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB address analytical query latency and licensing overhead?
